reader_summary.overview: Adam is the chairman and CEO of SANDOW Companies and the executive chairman and founder of Material Bank. He has built an entire ecosystem of businesses and brands that have brought him into the game of media, materials, and beyond. We discuss the founding stories of his most interesting companies, his obsession with targeting pain points.
